newsitem.title: USA: Transworld gets oks for Omnicare shrs.
newsitem.headline: Transworld gets oks for Omnicare shrs.

text.p: Transworld HealthCare Inc said Tuesday it received valid acceptances for 9,340,083 ordinary shares of Omicare PLC with respect to its offer to buy the company through its Transworld HealthCare Limited unit.
Transworld said the shares, together with the 1.765 million shares already owned by the unit, represent about 93 percent of the current outstanding share capital of Omnicare.
Transworld also said the offer to buy the balance of the outstanding shares will remain open until further notice.
Omnicare provides respiratory equipment and services to home care patients in the United Kingdom.
Transworld HealthCare is a regional provider of alternate site healthcare services and products.
